title: EVERY WE[AR] TOKYO
content:
![6f723940bbf6472e885b29380c97e3a5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/6f723940bbf6472e885b29380c97e3a5Main_01.png)

* * *

This design showcases urban wear for an AR-driven Tokyo, where the physical and digital realms seamlessly merge. Inspired by the flow and practicality of the traditional haori, this garment blends cutting-edge technology with modern day fashion.

![0627b954fa90470fa43748176f74ce59](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/0627b954fa90470fa43748176f74ce59Main_CU_03.png)

![53295c9bd92642c48c5fd4b0f6352cfa](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/53295c9bd92642c48c5fd4b0f6352cfaMain_CU_01.png)

The haori is a lightweight outer layer, intentionally plain and minimal to avoid drawing attention. It is crafted with textured recycled fabrics, subtle hexagonal patterns, and an emissive color that hints at an underlying technology.

![2e799ae450a042a8aebbe7cb16b1f30e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/2e799ae450a042a8aebbe7cb16b1f30eSuit_01_Final.png)

![7dbde137467d4a66a23cfe880947503e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/7dbde137467d4a66a23cfe880947503eSuit_02_Final.png)

![f5002cad620642018d9e6e812775ac8c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/f5002cad620642018d9e6e812775ac8cSuit_03_Final.png)

A sleek and high-tech ornamental layer, the haptic suit is engineered to simulate real-world sensations, creating a richer, more immersive experience. The flow of green neon lines across its surface visually represent its seamless connection to the energy source. 

![120dd6098ceb4370a106fee5a852c274](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/120dd6098ceb4370a106fee5a852c274Main_CU_02.png)

![c5f08a18d3fe44e891fa3964508c231b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/c5f08a18d3fe44e891fa3964508c231bShoe_01_Final_Updated.png)

![b00337f4edd64e07b865d2672ddeec82](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/b00337f4edd64e07b865d2672ddeec82Shoe_03_Final.png)

![bce5a401f94d4e2b8d16bc60cf09878d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/bce5a401f94d4e2b8d16bc60cf09878dShoe_02_Final.png)

Featuring piezoelectric materials, the shoes convert movement into electrical energy, offering a renewable power source for the suit.

* * *

![ae55c7c3fe654c6a8136c3ec7a53cade](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/ae55c7c3fe654c6a8136c3ec7a53cadeMD_01.png)![66a9ab0c21064371b3588985ee997603](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/e039ae66012843e29b9e001ce81ec028/images/66a9ab0c21064371b3588985ee997603MD_02.png)

title: Assassin's Creed Shadows: Official World Premiere Trailer
content:
## [_DIGIC Pictures,_](https://digicgroup.com/)_a multi-award-winning studio renowned for its AAA animation work, collaborated once again with Ubisoft to create the Assassin’s Creed Shadows: Official World Premiere Trailer. Set against the majestic backdrop of Japan, the trailer showcases DIGIC’s signature cinematic style and technical excellence._

* * *

YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P5YJMH-tksk?start=0

# **Interview with**[**DIGIC PICTURES**](https://digicgroup.com/)

# **Studio Introduction**

DIGIC is a multi-award-winning industry leader in creating AAA animation content for top-tier clients all over the world. With its established technology, supreme quality, and creative team of directors, cinematographers, and 3D artists, DIGIC understands the industry demands and delivers quality reliably. DIGIC team counts more than 300+ colleagues as of 2025.  


# **Could you introduce the recent project - Assassin's Creed Shadows?**

It had become a delightful tradition that, from time to time, Ubisoft approached us to help bring their newest Assassin's Creed trailer to life. As always, we were entrusted with creating the reveal trailer for their latest entry in the series, set in the stunning and majestic backdrop of Japan.

# ![091ed28b157741d38082cbaab08ef3dc](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/7167e9ab885f4be7af2152bdd53195d7/images/091ed28b157741d38082cbaab08ef3dcvlcsnap-2025-02-25-16h48m21s545.png)![feaca6c891f8426998a64bd1be97c54f](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/7167e9ab885f4be7af2152bdd53195d7/images/feaca6c891f8426998a64bd1be97c54fvlcsnap-2025-02-25-16h48m35s453.png)![17d8c28cd5c5483d85ae8de4fc89a649](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/7167e9ab885f4be7af2152bdd53195d7/images/17d8c28cd5c5483d85ae8de4fc89a649vlcsnap-2025-02-25-16h50m35s206.png)![91648a99156b480293b9383c97632af4](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/7167e9ab885f4be7af2152bdd53195d7/images/91648a99156b480293b9383c97632af4vlcsnap-2025-02-25-16h50m59s297.png)**How is Marvelous Designer integrated in the project pipeline?**

For this project, we decided to use Marvelous in two phases: at the start for modeling, and at the end for simulation. Initially, garments were created in Marvelous, then transferred to Maya for rigging, and finally brought back into Marvelous for simulation at the conclusion of the process.

# **Could you give examples of some of the iconic scenes and characters Marvelous Designer has been used for?**

Naoe, the main protagonist, wears garments created in Marvelous. The fight scenes during the attack on her native village in the first half of the cinematic showcase a stunning visual display of garments simulated in Marvelous, worn by both Naoe and the background villagers. The castle fight scenes and the forest chase highlight Naoe's assassin attire, which was also designed and simulated in Marvelous.

title: Meet the Winner: Creator's contest 2025 Vol.1 - Seifuku Decoded (2nd place, KSK)
content:
## _Hasn't the community been eagerly waiting for this interview? Check out the story and workflow of_[ _KSK (Keisuke Higashide)_](https://connect.clo-set.com/portfolio/204405/collection/collections)_, another winner of the recent Marvelous Designer Creator's Content Vol1!_

![ecb74a86d81b47bf9afcaae7e849c4bd](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/ecb74a86d81b47bf9afcaae7e849c4bdezgif-5f44da7b3696b3.png)

# **Artist Introduction: please tell us about yourself.**

Hello, I am Keisuke Higashide, I am a teacher at a design vocational school in Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan (Sapporo Designer Academy). I mainly teach fashion courses and costume design courses in the 3DCG field. This time, I applied because I was interested in the theme of reconstructing Japanese uniforms. In the current trend of uniformity in ready-made clothing, I believe that by merging existing designs with futuristic designs, we can discover new possibilities for design.

# **We’d like to hear more about the art direction in your Creator’s contest 2025 Vol.1 Seifuku Decoded Contest. What was the visual style you were aiming for?**

Since the theme was "Uniform Evolution," I focused on creating visuals that blend futuristic designs with archival elements, while preserving the essence of Japan. The concept is a world where traditional streetscapes, as depicted in Japanese animation, merge seamlessly with technology. Inspired by the uniforms of the Self-Defense Forces, I incorporated mechanical innerwear with old Japanese military harnesses and B-3 jackets, intentionally integrating historical designs. Being based in Hokkaido, I also paid attention to color schemes that blend into snowy environments.

![ca121f7e2691448b9e637362d2afa6b6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/ca121f7e2691448b9e637362d2afa6b6MD.jpg)

# **Would you be able to give us a quick overview of the different tools you use in your pipeline with a focus on Marvelous Designer? Have you encountered any challenges and how have you overcome them?**

The avatar was created in Vroid Studio and converted to FBX in Unity. After completing the design in Marvelous Designer, poses were added in Mixamo, exported as OBJ, and fur details were expressed in Blender for rendering. The rendered image was then edited in Photoshop to blur the background and add snow effects.

![210241bc8aaf433f99966564b67fa2a9](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/210241bc8aaf433f99966564b67fa2a9pose.jpg)![27410239df3540fcb613d1458174e20d](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/27410239df3540fcb613d1458174e20dpose_2.jpg)

![3f3c5bf4a18547139587d8b2d01d13b6](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/3f3c5bf4a18547139587d8b2d01d13b6blrnder.jpg)![cb0b489bfdce439b9564f2f87fb251d5](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/cb0b489bfdce439b9564f2f87fb251d5blender_2.jpg)![5722343da9514ad49af67fb9b2bacb9b](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/5722343da9514ad49af67fb9b2bacb9bphotoshop.jpg)

# **Are there any tips and tricks with Marvelous Designer that you can share with the community?**

Even without knowing the basic pattern prototypes, you can achieve a lot of expressions by modifying default T-shirts and pants. Additionally, depending on the physical properties of the fabric, textures, and materials, it's interesting to see that you can create expressions similar to hard surfaces.

![f699157b538c429081d755101e6a25e4](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/f699157b538c429081d755101e6a25e4pattern.jpg)![1f9096f57bc6448e8a22fd4efb3d1348](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/1f9096f57bc6448e8a22fd4efb3d1348pattern_2.jpg)

![bb8b7e78705341b5b8074a489c179a0c](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/bb8b7e78705341b5b8074a489c179a0cezgif-5fb1a4070fd9e1.png)![](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202505/c0fa082e996242929783bab9dd0d5655/images/be9e1768705e45f59ea4c10f19162d11%E1%84%89%E1%85%B3%E1%84%8F%E1%85%B3%E1%84%85%E1%85%B5%E1%86%AB%E1%84%89%E1%85%A3%E1%86%BA%202025-05-15%20%E1%84%8B%E1%85%A9%E1%84%92%E1%85%AE%206.30.44.png)
